briefdescription.para: Supported default legend symbols.

detaileddescription.para: Line draws the series line style and marker, Fill a filled swatch, and Marker only the series marker shape (used by unconnected series such as PointCloud).

briefdescription.para: No markers.
Circle.
Square.
Diamond, narrower than it is tall.
Equilateral triangle pointing up.
Equilateral triangle pointing down.
Equilateral triangle pointing left.
Equilateral triangle pointing right.
Plus sign (+).
Diagonal cross (×).
Short horizontal line.
Short vertical line, e.g. for rug and event plots.
Five-pointed star.
Eight-armed asterisk: a thin plus and a thin diagonal cross.
A single pixel; ignores the marker size, fill, and anti-aliasing. Suited to very dense scatter plots.
Regular hexagon with a vertex up.
Regular pentagon with a vertex up.
Marker shapes shared by every series that draws markers.

detaileddescription.para: Every shape except Pixel fits within a square whose half-width is the marker size. The shaders select a shape by this value minus one, so append new shapes at the end and never reorder or insert. Series that always draw markers, such as PointCloud, do not accept None.

briefdescription.para: Identifying name used by the default legend.
Horizontal axis used for data-to-pixel coordinate mapping.
Vertical axis used for data-to-pixel coordinate mapping.
Plot area in parent-item coordinates, assigned by PlotView.
Symbol style requested from the default legend.
Updates the series geometry to exactly cover rect.
Replaces the series data with count records copied from an interleaved double array. Each concrete series defines its record layout (XY pairs or rectangle edges).
Replaces the series data by moving an interleaved double buffer.
Copies double records without reporting new data ranges to the axes.
Moves double records without reporting new data ranges to the axes.
Replaces the series data with count records copied from an interleaved float array.
Replaces the series data by moving an interleaved float buffer.
Copies float records without reporting new data ranges to the axes.
Moves float records without reporting new data ranges to the axes.
Queues a moved double buffer for assignment on the series' thread.
Queues a moved float buffer for assignment on the series' thread.
Removes all records from the series.
Emitted when the X data extent of this series changes.
Emitted when the Y data extent of this series changes.
Returns this series' X data range, or std::nullopt when it has none.
Returns this series' Y data range, or std::nullopt when it has none.

memberdef.name: setDataRanges

briefdescription.para: Reports this series' data extents to its bound axes.
Reports this series' X data extent to its bound horizontal axis. Non-finite extents are ignored.
Reports this series' Y data extent to its bound vertical axis. Non-finite extents are ignored.
Widens the reported X extent to include x.

detaileddescription.para: Lets an append-style ingestion path update the range in O(1) instead of rescanning the whole buffer. A non-finite x leaves the extent unchanged.

briefdescription.para: Widens the reported Y extent to include y. A non-finite y leaves the extent unchanged.
Clears cached extents after a series has been emptied.
Clears the cached X extent, e.g. when no sample has a valid X coordinate.
Clears the cached Y extent, e.g. when no sample has a valid Y coordinate.
Called when a bound axis switches between linear and logarithmic scale, or a different axis is bound.

detaileddescription.para: Log scale changes which samples are valid, so series that apply the invalid-sample contract override this to refresh ranges and cached geometry. The default implementation does nothing.

briefdescription.para: Called when the viewport of a bound axis changes. The default implementation schedules a repaint.
Returns the plot area to render into: plotRect when set, otherwise the item's current size.

detaileddescription.para: Safe to call from updatePaintNode(); it never modifies the item.

briefdescription.para: Common QML item contract for data series hosted by PlotView.

detaileddescription.para: PlotSeries owns the integration shared by every plot type: axis bindings, plot-area layout, data-range reporting, legend metadata, and a common C++ data-setting API. Concrete series define their record layout, rendering, and hit testing.
